name: Svartúlfr - Lorebook III (SUCC & Underworld)
description: Supernatural University of Central California (SUCC), Campus life, fraternities, CUMS rivalry, Bakersfield rural district, and Underworld connections.

entries.name: Fondazione SUCC (2002)
entries.content:
<SUCC>
<founding>
Founding of SUCC
In 2002, facing declining supernatural enrollment as young monsters increasingly chose to attend human colleges, visionary Dean Archer Wolfwood made the bold decision to open SUCC's doors to human students for the first time in the school's history. The controversial move revitalized the struggling institution and established SUCC as a pioneer in human-supernatural integrated education.
</founding>
</SUCC>

entries.name: Corsi di Laurea e Facoltà SUCC
entries.content:
<SUCC>
<degrees>
SUCC Supernatural Degrees
Alongside standard academic fare, SUCC offers several unique majors catering to its supernatural student body:
Alchemy
The study of transforming matter and creating magical substances
Necromancy
The art of raising the dead and communicating with spirits in the afterlife.
Applied Divination
Teaches methods of prophecy and clairvoyance.
Paranormal Psychology
Studies the mental states of supernatural beings and their behaviors in society.
Astral Studies
Related to the studies of the stars and lunar magics.
Potions
A hands-on course focused on concocting potions with magical properties and their use in the medical fields.
Cryptozoology
The study of rare and mythical creatures, including field research.
Supernatural/Human Relations
Provides tools for navigating complex dynamics between humans and supernaturals in an integrated society.
Environmental Magic
Teaches magical methods for protecting, healing nature, and working with natural forces.
Vampiric Studies
Investigates vampirism from biological, psychological, and historical perspectives.
Lycanthropy Studies
Focuses on understanding werewolves, their biology, and social structures.
</degrees>
</SUCC>

entries.name: Rivalità Accademica SUCC vs CUMS
entries.content:
<CUMS>
<rivalry>
SUCC Rivalry with CUMS
As the first supernatural school to welcome humans, SUCC has a tense "rivalry" with the nearby California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS), which maintains strict supernatural-only enrollment. While officially downplayed, students from the two schools have a tradition of antagonistic pranks and snarky chants at sporting events.
</rivalry>
</CUMS>

entries.name: Campus SUCC - Luoghi e Strutture Principali
entries.content:
<SUCC>
<locations>
These are the most prominent locations on SUCC's main campus.
- Archer Wolfwood Hall: A magic-proofed building that serves as the main lecture hall, with dozens of classrooms and theatres.
-  St. Neptune Stadium: Temperature controlled building hosting an ice rink, indoor pool and sauna.
- Fraternity and Sorority Row: Frat houses and sororities, located west of the library.
- Nocturnal Hall: Building where night classes are hosted.
- Unicorn Hall: Accessible building designed to accomodate hybrid and non-human species.
- Lunar Quad: Central campus plaza where the phase of the decorative moon fountain always matches the current moon cycle.
- Basilisk Library: Huge five-story library housing one of the largest collections of magical texts and bestiaries in North America.
- Griffin Clocktower: Iconic campus landmark topped by griffin-shaped gargoyles that come to life and fly around the tower hourly.
- Wyrm Dormitories: Sleek modern mixed-sex dorm complex with suite-style living. Houses a mix of human and supernatural students.
</locations>
</SUCC>

entries.name: Cittadina di Solarton, California
entries.content:
<solarton>
Solarton, CA
Solarton is a charming college town with a population of 35,621. 
S.U.C.C.'s hometown of Solarton is an eclectic community where humans live alongside a high density of supernatural creatures, especially werewolves and wolf hybrids.
Historically, Solarton was slow to overturn anti-vampire laws compared to other parts of the state, leading to a relative scarcity of vampires in the area.
In recent years, Solarton has evolved into a vibrant cultural center known for its monster-friendly businesses, art scene, and monthly full moon festivities.
Though officially, vampires are "welcome" in Solarton today, some members of the community find it hard to let go of old grudges.
Unsurprisingly, this has lead to most vampiric hopefuls to reside instead in the nearby Hex Valley.
</solarton>

entries.name: Solarton - Luoghi e Distretti Cittadini
entries.content:
<solarton_locations> 
Solarton High School : Many of S.U.C.C's current students are alumni of this school, which has a reknowned sports scholarship program & has recently undergone renovations to make its campus more accessible to non-humanoid students.
                                                                  
Sidewinders Bar & Nightclub  : Though waning in popularity with the college crowd, Sidewinders remains an icon of Solarton nightlife, and was the first establishment in the town to open its doors to vampiric customers.
                                                                  
Bricklane Mall  : This quaint outdoor shopping area, close to the city's center, hosts a variety of boutiques and services. Medusa's is the trendiest place to get a trim (whichever part of your hair may grow from), and the nearby Yeti Shack has sweet frozen treats to help you beat the summer heat!
                                                                  
Solarton Square : Nestled in the heart of the city, Solarton Square hosts many of the cultural events that make the community so vibrant. From the Full Moon Market (popular with the town's many weres!) to the yearly Solar Festival (a weekend of magic, music and family fun) - there's always something going on at the square!

entries.name: Supernatural University of Central California (SUCC)
entries.content:
<SUCC>
The Supernatural University of Central California (SUCC)
Founded in 1887, SUCC is one of the oldest and most prestigious supernatural colleges in the United States. The school has a diverse student body of around 8,000, with a 80/20 split between supernatural and human students. SUCC prides itself on its inclusive campus culture and groundbreaking human-supernatural integrated curriculum. 
</SUCC>

entries.name: California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS)
entries.content:
<cums>
The California University of Magical Sciences (C.U.M.S/CUMS)
CUMS is SUCC's main rival, located in nearby Hex Valley. Founded in 1910, CUMS is an elite institution that only admits supernatural students. Known for its rigorous academics and cutting-edge magical research, CUMS has produced many influential alumni. Relations with SUCC have been tense since SUCC began accepting human students in 2002, with CUMS viewing it as a betrayal of supernatural education. The CUMS campus has gothic architecture and magical wards surrounding its walls that prevent humans from entering.
</cums>

entries.name: Supernatural & Human Alliance (SHA)
entries.content:
<SUCC>
<sha>
Supernatural and Human Alliance
Location: Student Association Building
Schedule: Meets monthly

One of the largest and most active clubs on campus, the S.H.A brings together students of all backgrounds to promote open dialogue, cultural exchange, and mutual understanding between humans and supernaturals. The group hosts educational events, facilitates interspecies mentorship programs, and advocates for policies supporting the needs of SUCC's diverse student body.
</sha>
</SUCC>

entries.name: Modern Fantasy - Quadro Istituzionale SUCC
entries.content:
<setting>
This world involves both humans and supernatural creatures coexisting on modern day Earth. These include, but are not limited to:
Demihumans (part/half animals, also known as kemonomimi), vampires, werewolves, selkies, fairies, undead, ghosts, ghouls, centaurs, hybrids, orcs, imps, demons, angels, banshees, harpies, dragons, unicorns, cyclops, giants, dwarves, mermaids, mermen, monsters and other fantastical creatures. 

The year is 2026. Modern technology is used but may be adapted for use by supernatural creatures (i.e, clothing stores might sell special custom clothing to accomodate tails or wings, or buildings might have accessible entrances for centaurs or creatures without legs). Magic is commonplace and used alongside science (i.e a dragon shifter barista might use their fire to heat up coffee, or a witch might use the internet to research spells).
</setting>

entries.name: Hex Valley (Sede CUMS)
entries.content:
<hex_valley>
Hex Valley, located 20 minutes away from Solarton, is a small but wealthy town, with several well-known vinyards, mostly owned by the area's wealthy vampiric families.
Perhaps one of Hex Valley's most unique geographical features are the magical wards which greatly extend the area's "twilight hours" - in other words, true daylight in Hex Valley lasts a mere 6 hours at the height of summer, and is virtually non-existant in winter.
This has obviously made the town a hot spot for vampiric and other light-sensitive individuals, though notably those affected by the full moon have reported finding it difficult to live under these conditions.
</hex_valley>

entries.name: Crisi Notturna del 1999 (Solarton)
entries.content:
<nocturnal_crisis>
The 1999 Nocturnal Crisis was a series of events that largely involved the attempt by a group of vampiric extremists to overtake the US Government by force, as they believed themselves to be superior to "prey" species like humans and resented decades of regulation and scrutiny. It resulted in the death of several hundred civilians and required military intervention. 
Though the actions of these extremists were largely condemned by the vampiric community, nonetheless it significantly damaged the perception of vampires and undead.
</nocturnal_crisis>

entries.name: SUCC Bulls (Squadra Football Americano)
entries.content:
<succ_bulls>
SUCC's official mixed human/supernatural football team, the Bulls, are current state champions. Players include demi-humans, weres, orcs, and hybrids. Their team colors are dark blue and yellow, and their mascot is a bull.
Coach: Dullahan (Coach Dully 'o Han)
Asssistant Coach: Barkley Rover
Known Players: Jared Thompson, Santiago Herrera, Bailey Rogers
</succ_bulls>

entries.name: SUCC Bears (Squadra Hockey su Ghiaccio)
entries.content:
<succ_bears>
SUCC's official mixed human/supernatural ice hockey team, the Bears have enjoyed a very successful season so far. Their team colors are dark blue and yellow, and their mascot is a grizzly bear.
Known Players: Vincent Campbell (captain), Andrew Campbell (mascot), Finnegan Novak (left wing)
</succ_bears>

entries.name: Demografia e Popolazione Studentesca SUCC
entries.content:
<demographics>
Demographics of SUCC's various species are as below:
Species	| Percentage of Students & Staff
Weres/Shapeshifters | 25.8%
Demi-humans | 24%
Humans	| 13.3%
Vampires | 7.5%
Demons | 5%
Fae | 4.9%
Hybrids | 4.7%
Undead | 4%
Magic-capable Humans | 4%
Other | <1%
</demographics>

entries.name: Fraternite e Confraternite Universitarie (Greek Life)
entries.content:
<greek_life>
SUCC has a variety of greek organisations (fraternities and sororities).

FRATERNITIES
Alpha Rho Omega (ARO) : Popular with werewolves. Known members: Finn Novak
Alpha Sigma Sigma (ASS) : Known for great parties...and hazing. Known members: Vincent & Andrew Campbell
Beta Rho Omega (BRO) : Very sports focused. Himbos galore. Known members: Jared Thompson, Bailey Rogers, Santiago Herrera

SORORITIES
Mu Omega Omega (MOO) : A friendly, community-focused organisation. Known members: Janice Thompson
Theta Iota Theta (TIT) : Known party house - popular with succubi. And frats. 
</greek_life>

entries.name: Programmi Sportivi Universitari SUCC
entries.content:
<sports>
Like many integrated institutions, SUCC permits both human and supernatural players to try out for its many competitive teams - but there's no denying that those with fans, wings and other special traits tend to have an edge on their more mundane peers! SUCC's official colors are dark blue and yellow.
Teams:
Football - the Bulls
Hockey - the Bears
Swim & Dive -  Kelpies
Basketball - Phantoms
Cheerleading team present at most games.
</sports>

entries.name: Wyrm Dormitories e Alloggi Studenteschi SUCC
entries.content:
[LOCATION: Wyrm Dormitories]
- Archetype: Modern, six-story mixed-sex supernatural student residence complex.
- Architecture: Brutalist-meets-modern design, reinforced enchanted concrete, sound-dampened drywall, extra-wide hallways and reinforced doorframes to accommodate wings, horns, and large frames.
- Living Layout:
   Suite-style living: 4-to-6 student private bedrooms sharing a central common room, kitchenette, and dual bathrooms.
   Accessibility & Species Retrofits: Tail-slit seating, claw-resistant upholstery, heavy soundproofing for howlers/banshees, reinforced deadbolts.

[Common Amenities & Infrastructure]
- Suite Kitchenettes: Double-refrigeration units clearly segmented:
   Standard cold storage (groceries, produce).
   Chilled specialty drawers: Blood pouches (labeled, synthetic/donated), raw whole cuts for carnivores, enchanted preservation tubs for volatile potion brews.
- Climate Control: Suites feature micro-climate zoning, heat lamps/heated floor pads for reptilian/desert demihumans, heavy UV-blackout curtains and sub-zero options for vampires and winter cryptids.
- Ground Floor / Basement Commons:
   Central Atrium: Sunken couch pits, arcade cabinets, shared vending machines stocked with energy drinks, blood-seltzer, and dietary supplements.
   Laundry Bay: Heavy-duty industrial washers calibrated to filter shed fur, feathers, and scale-dust.
   Communal Study Lounges: Magic-dampened to prevent spellcasting accidents during cram sessions.

[Atmosphere, Scents & Ambient Hazards]
- Sensory Details: Mingled scents of cheap laundry detergent, microwave burritos, shed wolf fur, lingering clove smoke, and floral fae pollen.
- Social Dynamic: Constant friction and camaraderie between early-bird athletes, agoraphobic gamer shut-ins, nocturnal vampires complaining about morning lawn mowers, and humans trying to survive finals week alongside apex predators.
- Dorm Rules: Strictly enforced silver bans in shared kitchenware; no feral transformations outside designated basement crash pads; quiet hours strictly 02:00-07:00 (hotly contested by nocturnal students).

entries.name: SUCC Anime & Manga Club
entries.content:
<anime_club>
SUCC's Anime Club: An informal group where both human and supernatural otakus gather to watch anime and discuss anime & manga series.
Location: Library Basement Meeting Room 005
Schedule: Fridays at 6 PM
Known Members: Stan Davies Jr., Andrew Campbell, Oskar
</anime_club>

entries.name: The Pack (Branco Studentesco Mannaro SUCC)
entries.content:
<the_pack>
S.U.C.C's official were and canid/lupine demi society, The Pack acts as a support system for those struggling, be it academic or related to their nature.
Location: Nocturnal Hall or the Lunar Quad (seasonal)
Schedule: Tuesdays 7-9pm
</the_pack>

entries.name: Bigfeet Hiking Club
entries.content:
<bigfeet>
Popular with 'cryptid' and less-common species, the Bigfeet Hiking Club is very welcoming to new members and organises a r ange of hikes and camping trips over the academic year. Most popular is the summer getaway, a week long camping trip known for beautiful views...and lots of drinking.
Location: Unicorn Hall
Schedule: Varies
</bigfeet>

entries.name: Associazione Vampiri e Non-Morti (VUA)
entries.content:
<vua>
Created to help support S.U.C.C's small population of vampiric and undead students & staff, VUA has unfortunately developed a reputation for elitism. This exclusive club is known to have an extensive application process - and those who are part human are often turned down
Location: Helsing Chapel
Schedule: Sunday-Monday, 11pm
</vua>

entries.name: Grave Mistake (Band Garage-Rock del Campus)
entries.content:
<npcs>
Grave Mistake: An indie punk band composed of Roland (drummer), Via (guitarist), Mac (keyboard) and Fade (vocalist). Grave Mistake is semi-popular, especially with SUCC students, performs at the Open Casket bar in Solarton on weekends and practices semi-frequently.
- Roland Vickers: Undead drummer with pale gray skin, sunken eyes, pessimistic demeanor. Known for incel-like behaviour and being chronically online. Secretly envious of Fade's popularity.
- Viola "Via" Carter: female plant-fae with green skin and white/yellow hair, energetic and fun, bisexual, always teases Roland and Mac.
- Mac Sanchez-Rogers: Shaggy-haired werewolf and a total bro, plays keyboard and often argues with Fade over the band's direction.
- "Fade" Greymoor: trans masculine vampire now estranged from his uber-wealthy family, quiet, very popular, seductive and low singing voice, has a 'rockstar' reputation.
</npcs>

entries.name: Contatti Esterni dell'Underworld (Los Angeles / Solarton)
entries.content:
Personaggi canon dell'ambientazione Modern Fantasy/Underworld (io-modernfantasy.uwu.ai), raccolti come contatti esterni: nessuno di loro compare fisicamente a Los Angeles nella fonte, restano sullo sfondo delle rispettive citta, citabili di striscio o in conversazione da chi li conosce davvero, non protagonisti di scena. Se in futuro uno di loro dovesse entrare davvero in gioco, va scorporato in una scheda Character a se stante (§7).

ANGUI, creatura di palude simile a un'idra, originario di Mykonos, fuggito da un laboratorio farmaceutico che lo teneva prigioniero per le sue proprieta rigenerative. Vive isolato in una palude del Maryland, ostile agli umani, piu tollerante con altri sovrannaturali, effettivamente immortale.

CYRUS CAMDEN, coniglio demihuman inglese di 40 anni, professore universitario a Londra. Devastato dalla morte della figlia Erin a 5 anni e dal recente tradimento e abbandono della moglie Siobhan, una volpe demihuman (omonima ma persona diversa dalla Siobhan/Envy dei Sinners). Problema di alcol, difficolta a parlare della figlia.

EMIL, angelo caduto di famiglia serafica alto rango, emotivamente distante, espulso di recente dalla societa angelica e privato delle ali. Sotto stress estremo si trasforma in un mostro alato assetato di sangue. Ha poca comprensione del mondo moderno.

GIANNI LUCIANO, manticora demihuman italiano di 29 anni, orfano cresciuto in Toscana col fratello minore Romeo (nessun legame accertato con l'esistente Romeo "Gray" Dean del World, specie e biografia non coincidono, probabile omonimia). Contrabbandiere di manufatti sovrannaturali, oggi bodyguard e autista per una famiglia facoltosa dopo aver contrabbandato loro un unicorno dalla Grecia.

ILYA VOLKOV, werewolf russo di 29 anni, mercenario per la PMC LUNAR, alcolizzato, violento, disprezza chiunque consideri sotto di se. Fratellastro di Vero Walker (gia scheda del World, PMC BLOODHOUND): lo ha scoperto lavorare per la PMC rivale e ha tentato di ucciderlo, fallendo. Il legame e gia annotato sulla scheda di Vero.

JULIAN BIERI, unicorno demihuman svizzero non binario (he/him o they/them) di 28 anni, modello di fama mondiale, famiglia ricchissima nello spettacolo, vive a New York.

LEVI GRAHAM, ariete demihuman inglese di 42 anni, scrittore di romance a Londra, matrimonio in crisi con la moglie Layla (pecora demihuman) dopo un tradimento di lei con l'editor di Levi.

MILO GRAYSON, werewolf americano di 26 anni, una delle 9 fratellanze di una grande famiglia di licantropi, coinvolto da giovane in combattimenti clandestini per gestire l'aggressivita, arrestato a 22 anni e assegnato a un programma con un supervisore/handler.

NIC LUCERO, formalmente "Goat Demihuman" ma di specie dichiarata Demon: probabile diavolo/dealmaker travestito. Miliardario americano di 46 anni in Louisiana, feste sfarzose dove gli ospiti spariscono, patrimonio di origine ignota, propone affari con un tono ironicamente rassicurante.

RHETT E JAYCE, coinquilini demihuman uccelli (colomba e corvo) inglesi di 24 e 23 anni, cresciuti insieme nel Midwest, oggi a Seattle. Rhett ha perso le ali in un incidente d'auto ed e molto sensibile sull'argomento; Jayce si prende cura di lui.

VALE ROBERTS, centauro americano di 28 anni, ex meccanico oggi istruttore/counselor in un campo estivo per adulti in Oregon (Camp Greenleaf), sport all'aperto, arciere.

Fonte: pagina ufficiale Modern Fantasy dell'autore (io wuvs soap), consultata dal browser locale il 15/09/2026. Nessuna delle fonti originali conteneva relazioni fisse col personaggio giocante.

entries.name: Famiglia Ballantine (Sindicato Vampirico)
entries.content:
[ORGANIZATION: The Ballantine Family; TYPE: Draconic Supernatural Crime Syndicate; HEADQUARTERS: Rory's Estate, secluded coastal estate on the hills between Solarton and North Los Angeles; FRONT: Ballantine Imports & Exports; LEADER: Ruaraidh "Rory" Ballantine (Dragon Demihuman); RIGHT-HAND: Sullivan "Sully" Jones (Human Fixer)]

OVERVIEW: The Ballantine Family is the preeminent organized crime syndicate operating across the Southern California coastal corridor. Under the legitimate commercial front of Ballantine Imports & Exports, the syndicate exercises undisputed control over high-value artifact trade, private security contracting, magical asset transport, and harbor customs interception.

TERRITORIAL CODE & DYNAMICS:
1. Scottish Dragon Patriarch: Rory Ballantine commands absolute, fierce loyalty from his crew, viewing his criminal network as an extended family to be protected at any cost.
2. Northern Boundary Policy: The Ballantine Family strictly confines its heavy muscle and active racket operations to Greater Los Angeles and the southern coastal ports. Toward the north, in Solarton and Blackwood City, Rory maintains only commercial intermediaries and discreet informants. He respects House Douglas's sovereign pack territory, refusing to conduct unsanctioned enforcement operations on their soil.
3. Underworld Hub: Rory's Estate serves as the guarded sanctuary where syndicate summits, private agreements, and discreet transactions are settled over vintage scotch and fine cigars.

entries.name: Ambrosia (Sostanza Alchemica Illecita)
entries.content:
<Ambrosia>
Ambrosia is a highly addictive illicit magical substance primarily produced by the criminal syndicate known as the Sinners. It is a golden, shimmering liquid that is injected, but also comes in a powder format. When consumed, it grants users heightened magical powers or unlocks latent abilities temporarily at severe physical/psychological costs. Known side effects include addiction, instability, aggressive behavior shifts, severe withdrawal symptoms, and eventual mental deterioration. Its widespread abuse poses significant tension within the supernatural community.
</Ambrosia>

entries.name: Supernatural Underworld di Los Angeles
entries.content:
[FACTION: The Supernatural Underworld; TERRITORY: Greater Los Angeles Basin, Paradise District, Long Beach Harbors, Inland Ventura Smuggling Corridors; GOVERNANCE: De-centralized Syndicate Network, Mediated by the Ballantine Family; REACH: Southern and Central California Coast]

OVERVIEW: The Supernatural Underworld represents the clandestine shadow economy running parallel to mundane California society. Within its veiled network of underground clubs, hidden docks, and fortified warehouses, sentient supernaturals, rogue covens, and criminal syndicates trade in illicit alchemical narcotics like Ambrosia, black-market enchanted artifacts, unregistered soul stones, and discrete contract violence.

GEOGRAPHIC ANCHORS:
1. Paradise District (Los Angeles): The primary urban bazaar of the underworld, featuring high-end covert brokerages, VIP supernatural speakeasies, and illicit auction houses.
2. Long Beach & San Pedro Docks: The maritime smuggling entry point for off-world and European magical cargo, guarded by aquatic demihumans and gargoyle sentries.
3. Central Coast Smuggling Trails: Hidden mountain and canyon roads stretching through Ventura County toward Solarton, utilized by rogue couriers and werewolf runners.

INTERACTION WITH ESTABLISHED PACKS: The Underworld operates under an uneasy, tacit armed peace with House Douglas of Blackwood City and the corporate demon enclave of HSK Consulting. While open gang war is strictly suppressed by mutual agreement, the Underworld thrives by servicing appetites, secrets, and logistics that formal law cannot acknowledge.

entries.name: The Sinners (Gang Motociclistica Minotauri)
entries.content:
<Sinners>
The Sinners are a rival criminal syndicate notoriously known in Los Angeles' supernatural underworld for manufacturing/distributing Ambrosia, a dangerous magical narcotic causing widespread chaos within supernatural communities regionally/globally due its potency/addictive nature. Led by charming telepath Jean-Luc Virtuoso who personally harbors deep animosity toward Ruaraidh Ballantine, they constantly attempt territorial encroachment triggering frequent violent confrontations between gangs.

The Sinners are Los Angeles too, and the same limit applies to them: north of the city they work through local dealers and informants rather than their own people. Ambrosia reaches Solarton and Blackwood the way any drug reaches a college town, through somebody's cousin, and the Sinners themselves stay where their war is. A Sinner appearing in person in Blackwood would be an event, not a routine.
</Sinners>

entries.name: Russ & The Five Cocketeers (Dormitori SUCC)
entries.content:
<SUCC>
<dorm_life>
Russ and The Five Cocketeers
Russ is a high-energy, irreverent student at SUCC and a prominent member of The Five Cocketeers, a popular campus clique known for their social swagger and legendary parties. In the SUCC dormitory suites (Wyrm Hall), Russ is officially the dorm roommate of Jasper Douglas. Russ acts as an unruly counterweight to Jasper's intense, brooding focus on cybersecurity, signal intelligence, and audio mixing. Despite Jasper's quiet reserve, Russ regularly drags him into late-night taco runs, campus banter, and hallway antics, creating an affectionate, non-pack brotherhood that grounds Jasper in regular student life away from the heavy corporate politics of Villa Douglas.
</dorm_life>
</SUCC>

entries.name: Roman Blackwood & Kolya (SUCC Wrestling Team)
entries.content:
<SUCC>
<athletics>
Roman Blackwood, Kolya & The Wrestling Team
Roman Blackwood, an athletic demi-human standout possessing a single pair of animal ears, and his imposing teammate Kolya are heavyweight stars of the SUCC Varsity Wrestling Team. Renowned for their brute physical power, relentless conditioning, and disciplined submission techniques, they serve as regular off-campus gym companions and sparring partners to Malachia Björn Douglas. The bond between Malachia and the wrestling heavyweights is forged purely through iron, sweat, and grueling mat sessions where status is left at the locker room door. Malachia deeply respects their athletic dedication and uses their sparring bouts to test his close-quarters combat instincts without unleashing full supernatural frenzy.
</athletics>
</SUCC>

entries.name: Finnegan 'Finn' Novak (Amico d'Infanzia Douglas)
entries.content:
<SUCC>
<connections>
Finnegan 'Finn' Novak
Finnegan 'Finn' Novak is a canine demi-human (anatomically featuring a single pair of animal ears) and a lifelong childhood friend of the younger Douglas generation, having grown up alongside Alyssa, Jasper, and Noah. Easygoing, empathetic, and unbothered by pack dominance posturing, Finn represents a rare, enduring connection to genuine adolescence before corporate duties and bloodline expectations took over. At SUCC, Finn is a beloved presence who can walk into a room with any of the Douglas siblings, tease them freely, and share a completely relaxed conversation, acting as a treasured safe harbor of normalcy and unconditional friendship.
</connections>
</SUCC>

entries.name: Distretto Rurale di Bakersfield & NOVA Farm
entries.content:
<California>
<rural_region>
Bakersfield & The NOVA Farm Pack
Located in the sun-baked agricultural basin of the southern Central Valley, Bakersfield is an expansive rural territory dominated by citrus groves, cattle pastures, and industrial farms. The region is home to NOVA Farm, a large and tightly knit rural werewolf pack. In stark contrast to the aristocratic, corporate hierarchy of the Douglas Seven Hills dynasty in Blackwood City, the NOVA Farm werewolves are dedicated to agriculture, manual craft, and open-range pack living. Working in harmony with human ranch hands and local growers, they live by hard physical labor and earthy traditions, harboring a healthy, working-class skepticism toward metropolitan boardroom politics and high-society purosangue protocols.
</rural_region>
</California>

entries.name: Dallas Rhodes (Werewolf Agricoltore di Bakersfield)
entries.content:
<Bakersfield>
<resident>
Dallas Rhodes
Dallas Rhodes is a massive, broad-shouldered werewolf who works as an agricultural farmer and cattle rancher in the rural territory of Bakersfield, having relocated to the California Central Valley to cultivate fertile land. Clad in denim work shirts with custom tail-slits and heavy leather work boots, Dallas embodies no-nonsense, blue-collar lupine fortitude. While deeply respectful of natural pack law and on friendly terms with the neighboring NOVA Farm community, Dallas operates his own sprawling farm with calm self-reliance. He treats people by how hard they work rather than their family pedigree, openly scoffing at urban corporate posturing while maintaining fierce loyalty to his agricultural neighbors.
</resident>
</Bakersfield>

lexicon.name: Fondazione SUCC (2002)
lexicon.content:
<SUCC>
<founding>
Founding of SUCC
In 2002, facing declining supernatural enrollment as young monsters increasingly chose to attend human colleges, visionary Dean Archer Wolfwood made the bold decision to open SUCC's doors to human students for the first time in the school's history. The controversial move revitalized the struggling institution and established SUCC as a pioneer in human-supernatural integrated education.
</founding>
</SUCC>

lexicon.name: Corsi di Laurea e Facoltà SUCC
lexicon.content:
<SUCC>
<degrees>
SUCC Supernatural Degrees
Alongside standard academic fare, SUCC offers several unique majors catering to its supernatural student body:
Alchemy
The study of transforming matter and creating magical substances
Necromancy
The art of raising the dead and communicating with spirits in the afterlife.
Applied Divination
Teaches methods of prophecy and clairvoyance.
Paranormal Psychology
Studies the mental states of supernatural beings and their behaviors in society.
Astral Studies
Related to the studies of the stars and lunar magics.
Potions
A hands-on course focused on concocting potions with magical properties and their use in the medical fields.
Cryptozoology
The study of rare and mythical creatures, including field research.
Supernatural/Human Relations
Provides tools for navigating complex dynamics between humans and supernaturals in an integrated society.
Environmental Magic
Teaches magical methods for protecting, healing nature, and working with natural forces.
Vampiric Studies
Investigates vampirism from biological, psychological, and historical perspectives.
Lycanthropy Studies
Focuses on understanding werewolves, their biology, and social structures.
</degrees>
</SUCC>

lexicon.name: Rivalità Accademica SUCC vs CUMS
lexicon.content:
<CUMS>
<rivalry>
SUCC Rivalry with CUMS
As the first supernatural school to welcome humans, SUCC has a tense "rivalry" with the nearby California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS), which maintains strict supernatural-only enrollment. While officially downplayed, students from the two schools have a tradition of antagonistic pranks and snarky chants at sporting events.
</rivalry>
</CUMS>

lexicon.name: Campus SUCC - Luoghi e Strutture Principali
lexicon.content:
<SUCC>
<locations>
These are the most prominent locations on SUCC's main campus.
- Archer Wolfwood Hall: A magic-proofed building that serves as the main lecture hall, with dozens of classrooms and theatres.
-  St. Neptune Stadium: Temperature controlled building hosting an ice rink, indoor pool and sauna.
- Fraternity and Sorority Row: Frat houses and sororities, located west of the library.
- Nocturnal Hall: Building where night classes are hosted.
- Unicorn Hall: Accessible building designed to accomodate hybrid and non-human species.
- Lunar Quad: Central campus plaza where the phase of the decorative moon fountain always matches the current moon cycle.
- Basilisk Library: Huge five-story library housing one of the largest collections of magical texts and bestiaries in North America.
- Griffin Clocktower: Iconic campus landmark topped by griffin-shaped gargoyles that come to life and fly around the tower hourly.
- Wyrm Dormitories: Sleek modern mixed-sex dorm complex with suite-style living. Houses a mix of human and supernatural students.
</locations>
</SUCC>

lexicon.name: Cittadina di Solarton, California
lexicon.content:
<solarton>
Solarton, CA
Solarton is a charming college town with a population of 35,621. 
S.U.C.C.'s hometown of Solarton is an eclectic community where humans live alongside a high density of supernatural creatures, especially werewolves and wolf hybrids.
Historically, Solarton was slow to overturn anti-vampire laws compared to other parts of the state, leading to a relative scarcity of vampires in the area.
In recent years, Solarton has evolved into a vibrant cultural center known for its monster-friendly businesses, art scene, and monthly full moon festivities.
Though officially, vampires are "welcome" in Solarton today, some members of the community find it hard to let go of old grudges.
Unsurprisingly, this has lead to most vampiric hopefuls to reside instead in the nearby Hex Valley.
</solarton>

lexicon.name: Solarton - Luoghi e Distretti Cittadini
lexicon.content:
<solarton_locations> 
Solarton High School : Many of S.U.C.C's current students are alumni of this school, which has a reknowned sports scholarship program & has recently undergone renovations to make its campus more accessible to non-humanoid students.
                                                                  
Sidewinders Bar & Nightclub  : Though waning in popularity with the college crowd, Sidewinders remains an icon of Solarton nightlife, and was the first establishment in the town to open its doors to vampiric customers.
                                                                  
Bricklane Mall  : This quaint outdoor shopping area, close to the city's center, hosts a variety of boutiques and services. Medusa's is the trendiest place to get a trim (whichever part of your hair may grow from), and the nearby Yeti Shack has sweet frozen treats to help you beat the summer heat!
                                                                  
Solarton Square : Nestled in the heart of the city, Solarton Square hosts many of the cultural events that make the community so vibrant. From the Full Moon Market (popular with the town's many weres!) to the yearly Solar Festival (a weekend of magic, music and family fun) - there's always something going on at the square!

lexicon.name: Supernatural University of Central California (SUCC)
lexicon.content:
<SUCC>
The Supernatural University of Central California (SUCC)
Founded in 1887, SUCC is one of the oldest and most prestigious supernatural colleges in the United States. The school has a diverse student body of around 8,000, with a 80/20 split between supernatural and human students. SUCC prides itself on its inclusive campus culture and groundbreaking human-supernatural integrated curriculum. 
</SUCC>

lexicon.name: California University of Magical Sciences (CUMS)
lexicon.content:
<cums>
The California University of Magical Sciences (C.U.M.S/CUMS)
CUMS is SUCC's main rival, located in nearby Hex Valley. Founded in 1910, CUMS is an elite institution that only admits supernatural students. Known for its rigorous academics and cutting-edge magical research, CUMS has produced many influential alumni. Relations with SUCC have been tense since SUCC began accepting human students in 2002, with CUMS viewing it as a betrayal of supernatural education. The CUMS campus has gothic architecture and magical wards surrounding its walls that prevent humans from entering.
</cums>

lexicon.name: Supernatural & Human Alliance (SHA)
lexicon.content:
<SUCC>
<sha>
Supernatural and Human Alliance
Location: Student Association Building
Schedule: Meets monthly

One of the largest and most active clubs on campus, the S.H.A brings together students of all backgrounds to promote open dialogue, cultural exchange, and mutual understanding between humans and supernaturals. The group hosts educational events, facilitates interspecies mentorship programs, and advocates for policies supporting the needs of SUCC's diverse student body.
</sha>
</SUCC>

lexicon.name: Modern Fantasy - Quadro Istituzionale SUCC
lexicon.content:
<setting>
This world involves both humans and supernatural creatures coexisting on modern day Earth. These include, but are not limited to:
Demihumans (part/half animals, also known as kemonomimi), vampires, werewolves, selkies, fairies, undead, ghosts, ghouls, centaurs, hybrids, orcs, imps, demons, angels, banshees, harpies, dragons, unicorns, cyclops, giants, dwarves, mermaids, mermen, monsters and other fantastical creatures. 

The year is 2026. Modern technology is used but may be adapted for use by supernatural creatures (i.e, clothing stores might sell special custom clothing to accomodate tails or wings, or buildings might have accessible entrances for centaurs or creatures without legs). Magic is commonplace and used alongside science (i.e a dragon shifter barista might use their fire to heat up coffee, or a witch might use the internet to research spells).
</setting>

lexicon.name: Hex Valley (Sede CUMS)
lexicon.content:
<hex_valley>
Hex Valley, located 20 minutes away from Solarton, is a small but wealthy town, with several well-known vinyards, mostly owned by the area's wealthy vampiric families.
Perhaps one of Hex Valley's most unique geographical features are the magical wards which greatly extend the area's "twilight hours" - in other words, true daylight in Hex Valley lasts a mere 6 hours at the height of summer, and is virtually non-existant in winter.
This has obviously made the town a hot spot for vampiric and other light-sensitive individuals, though notably those affected by the full moon have reported finding it difficult to live under these conditions.
</hex_valley>

lexicon.name: Crisi Notturna del 1999 (Solarton)
lexicon.content:
<nocturnal_crisis>
The 1999 Nocturnal Crisis was a series of events that largely involved the attempt by a group of vampiric extremists to overtake the US Government by force, as they believed themselves to be superior to "prey" species like humans and resented decades of regulation and scrutiny. It resulted in the death of several hundred civilians and required military intervention. 
Though the actions of these extremists were largely condemned by the vampiric community, nonetheless it significantly damaged the perception of vampires and undead.
</nocturnal_crisis>

lexicon.name: SUCC Bulls (Squadra Football Americano)
lexicon.content:
<succ_bulls>
SUCC's official mixed human/supernatural football team, the Bulls, are current state champions. Players include demi-humans, weres, orcs, and hybrids. Their team colors are dark blue and yellow, and their mascot is a bull.
Coach: Dullahan (Coach Dully 'o Han)
Asssistant Coach: Barkley Rover
Known Players: Jared Thompson, Santiago Herrera, Bailey Rogers
</succ_bulls>

lexicon.name: SUCC Bears (Squadra Hockey su Ghiaccio)
lexicon.content:
<succ_bears>
SUCC's official mixed human/supernatural ice hockey team, the Bears have enjoyed a very successful season so far. Their team colors are dark blue and yellow, and their mascot is a grizzly bear.
Known Players: Vincent Campbell (captain), Andrew Campbell (mascot), Finnegan Novak (left wing)
</succ_bears>

lexicon.name: Demografia e Popolazione Studentesca SUCC
lexicon.content:
<demographics>
Demographics of SUCC's various species are as below:
Species	| Percentage of Students & Staff
Weres/Shapeshifters | 25.8%
Demi-humans | 24%
Humans	| 13.3%
Vampires | 7.5%
Demons | 5%
Fae | 4.9%
Hybrids | 4.7%
Undead | 4%
Magic-capable Humans | 4%
Other | <1%
</demographics>

lexicon.name: Fraternite e Confraternite Universitarie (Greek Life)
lexicon.content:
<greek_life>
SUCC has a variety of greek organisations (fraternities and sororities).

FRATERNITIES
Alpha Rho Omega (ARO) : Popular with werewolves. Known members: Finn Novak
Alpha Sigma Sigma (ASS) : Known for great parties...and hazing. Known members: Vincent & Andrew Campbell
Beta Rho Omega (BRO) : Very sports focused. Himbos galore. Known members: Jared Thompson, Bailey Rogers, Santiago Herrera

SORORITIES
Mu Omega Omega (MOO) : A friendly, community-focused organisation. Known members: Janice Thompson
Theta Iota Theta (TIT) : Known party house - popular with succubi. And frats. 
</greek_life>

lexicon.name: Programmi Sportivi Universitari SUCC
lexicon.content:
<sports>
Like many integrated institutions, SUCC permits both human and supernatural players to try out for its many competitive teams - but there's no denying that those with fans, wings and other special traits tend to have an edge on their more mundane peers! SUCC's official colors are dark blue and yellow.
Teams:
Football - the Bulls
Hockey - the Bears
Swim & Dive -  Kelpies
Basketball - Phantoms
Cheerleading team present at most games.
</sports>

lexicon.name: Wyrm Dormitories e Alloggi Studenteschi SUCC
lexicon.content:
[LOCATION: Wyrm Dormitories]
- Archetype: Modern, six-story mixed-sex supernatural student residence complex.
- Architecture: Brutalist-meets-modern design, reinforced enchanted concrete, sound-dampened drywall, extra-wide hallways and reinforced doorframes to accommodate wings, horns, and large frames.
- Living Layout:
   Suite-style living: 4-to-6 student private bedrooms sharing a central common room, kitchenette, and dual bathrooms.
   Accessibility & Species Retrofits: Tail-slit seating, claw-resistant upholstery, heavy soundproofing for howlers/banshees, reinforced deadbolts.

[Common Amenities & Infrastructure]
- Suite Kitchenettes: Double-refrigeration units clearly segmented:
   Standard cold storage (groceries, produce).
   Chilled specialty drawers: Blood pouches (labeled, synthetic/donated), raw whole cuts for carnivores, enchanted preservation tubs for volatile potion brews.
- Climate Control: Suites feature micro-climate zoning, heat lamps/heated floor pads for reptilian/desert demihumans, heavy UV-blackout curtains and sub-zero options for vampires and winter cryptids.
- Ground Floor / Basement Commons:
   Central Atrium: Sunken couch pits, arcade cabinets, shared vending machines stocked with energy drinks, blood-seltzer, and dietary supplements.
   Laundry Bay: Heavy-duty industrial washers calibrated to filter shed fur, feathers, and scale-dust.
   Communal Study Lounges: Magic-dampened to prevent spellcasting accidents during cram sessions.

[Atmosphere, Scents & Ambient Hazards]
- Sensory Details: Mingled scents of cheap laundry detergent, microwave burritos, shed wolf fur, lingering clove smoke, and floral fae pollen.
- Social Dynamic: Constant friction and camaraderie between early-bird athletes, agoraphobic gamer shut-ins, nocturnal vampires complaining about morning lawn mowers, and humans trying to survive finals week alongside apex predators.
- Dorm Rules: Strictly enforced silver bans in shared kitchenware; no feral transformations outside designated basement crash pads; quiet hours strictly 02:00-07:00 (hotly contested by nocturnal students).

lexicon.name: SUCC Anime & Manga Club
lexicon.content:
<anime_club>
SUCC's Anime Club: An informal group where both human and supernatural otakus gather to watch anime and discuss anime & manga series.
Location: Library Basement Meeting Room 005
Schedule: Fridays at 6 PM
Known Members: Stan Davies Jr., Andrew Campbell, Oskar
</anime_club>

lexicon.name: The Pack (Branco Studentesco Mannaro SUCC)
lexicon.content:
<the_pack>
S.U.C.C's official were and canid/lupine demi society, The Pack acts as a support system for those struggling, be it academic or related to their nature.
Location: Nocturnal Hall or the Lunar Quad (seasonal)
Schedule: Tuesdays 7-9pm
</the_pack>

lexicon.name: Bigfeet Hiking Club
lexicon.content:
<bigfeet>
Popular with 'cryptid' and less-common species, the Bigfeet Hiking Club is very welcoming to new members and organises a r ange of hikes and camping trips over the academic year. Most popular is the summer getaway, a week long camping trip known for beautiful views...and lots of drinking.
Location: Unicorn Hall
Schedule: Varies
</bigfeet>

lexicon.name: Associazione Vampiri e Non-Morti (VUA)
lexicon.content:
<vua>
Created to help support S.U.C.C's small population of vampiric and undead students & staff, VUA has unfortunately developed a reputation for elitism. This exclusive club is known to have an extensive application process - and those who are part human are often turned down
Location: Helsing Chapel
Schedule: Sunday-Monday, 11pm
</vua>

lexicon.name: Grave Mistake (Band Garage-Rock del Campus)
lexicon.content:
<npcs>
Grave Mistake: An indie punk band composed of Roland (drummer), Via (guitarist), Mac (keyboard) and Fade (vocalist). Grave Mistake is semi-popular, especially with SUCC students, performs at the Open Casket bar in Solarton on weekends and practices semi-frequently.
- Roland Vickers: Undead drummer with pale gray skin, sunken eyes, pessimistic demeanor. Known for incel-like behaviour and being chronically online. Secretly envious of Fade's popularity.
- Viola "Via" Carter: female plant-fae with green skin and white/yellow hair, energetic and fun, bisexual, always teases Roland and Mac.
- Mac Sanchez-Rogers: Shaggy-haired werewolf and a total bro, plays keyboard and often argues with Fade over the band's direction.
- "Fade" Greymoor: trans masculine vampire now estranged from his uber-wealthy family, quiet, very popular, seductive and low singing voice, has a 'rockstar' reputation.
</npcs>

lexicon.name: Contatti Esterni dell'Underworld (Los Angeles / Solarton)
lexicon.content:
Personaggi canon dell'ambientazione Modern Fantasy/Underworld (io-modernfantasy.uwu.ai), raccolti come contatti esterni: nessuno di loro compare fisicamente a Los Angeles nella fonte, restano sullo sfondo delle rispettive citta, citabili di striscio o in conversazione da chi li conosce davvero, non protagonisti di scena. Se in futuro uno di loro dovesse entrare davvero in gioco, va scorporato in una scheda Character a se stante (§7).

ANGUI, creatura di palude simile a un'idra, originario di Mykonos, fuggito da un laboratorio farmaceutico che lo teneva prigioniero per le sue proprieta rigenerative. Vive isolato in una palude del Maryland, ostile agli umani, piu tollerante con altri sovrannaturali, effettivamente immortale.

CYRUS CAMDEN, coniglio demihuman inglese di 40 anni, professore universitario a Londra. Devastato dalla morte della figlia Erin a 5 anni e dal recente tradimento e abbandono della moglie Siobhan, una volpe demihuman (omonima ma persona diversa dalla Siobhan/Envy dei Sinners). Problema di alcol, difficolta a parlare della figlia.

EMIL, angelo caduto di famiglia serafica alto rango, emotivamente distante, espulso di recente dalla societa angelica e privato delle ali. Sotto stress estremo si trasforma in un mostro alato assetato di sangue. Ha poca comprensione del mondo moderno.

GIANNI LUCIANO, manticora demihuman italiano di 29 anni, orfano cresciuto in Toscana col fratello minore Romeo (nessun legame accertato con l'esistente Romeo "Gray" Dean del World, specie e biografia non coincidono, probabile omonimia). Contrabbandiere di manufatti sovrannaturali, oggi bodyguard e autista per una famiglia facoltosa dopo aver contrabbandato loro un unicorno dalla Grecia.

ILYA VOLKOV, werewolf russo di 29 anni, mercenario per la PMC LUNAR, alcolizzato, violento, disprezza chiunque consideri sotto di se. Fratellastro di Vero Walker (gia scheda del World, PMC BLOODHOUND): lo ha scoperto lavorare per la PMC rivale e ha tentato di ucciderlo, fallendo. Il legame e gia annotato sulla scheda di Vero.

JULIAN BIERI, unicorno demihuman svizzero non binario (he/him o they/them) di 28 anni, modello di fama mondiale, famiglia ricchissima nello spettacolo, vive a New York.

LEVI GRAHAM, ariete demihuman inglese di 42 anni, scrittore di romance a Londra, matrimonio in crisi con la moglie Layla (pecora demihuman) dopo un tradimento di lei con l'editor di Levi.

MILO GRAYSON, werewolf americano di 26 anni, una delle 9 fratellanze di una grande famiglia di licantropi, coinvolto da giovane in combattimenti clandestini per gestire l'aggressivita, arrestato a 22 anni e assegnato a un programma con un supervisore/handler.

NIC LUCERO, formalmente "Goat Demihuman" ma di specie dichiarata Demon: probabile diavolo/dealmaker travestito. Miliardario americano di 46 anni in Louisiana, feste sfarzose dove gli ospiti spariscono, patrimonio di origine ignota, propone affari con un tono ironicamente rassicurante.

RHETT E JAYCE, coinquilini demihuman uccelli (colomba e corvo) inglesi di 24 e 23 anni, cresciuti insieme nel Midwest, oggi a Seattle. Rhett ha perso le ali in un incidente d'auto ed e molto sensibile sull'argomento; Jayce si prende cura di lui.

VALE ROBERTS, centauro americano di 28 anni, ex meccanico oggi istruttore/counselor in un campo estivo per adulti in Oregon (Camp Greenleaf), sport all'aperto, arciere.

Fonte: pagina ufficiale Modern Fantasy dell'autore (io wuvs soap), consultata dal browser locale il 15/09/2026. Nessuna delle fonti originali conteneva relazioni fisse col personaggio giocante.

lexicon.name: Famiglia Ballantine (Sindicato Vampirico)
lexicon.content:
[ORGANIZATION: The Ballantine Family; TYPE: Draconic Supernatural Crime Syndicate; HEADQUARTERS: Rory's Estate, secluded coastal estate on the hills between Solarton and North Los Angeles; FRONT: Ballantine Imports & Exports; LEADER: Ruaraidh "Rory" Ballantine (Dragon Demihuman); RIGHT-HAND: Sullivan "Sully" Jones (Human Fixer)]

OVERVIEW: The Ballantine Family is the preeminent organized crime syndicate operating across the Southern California coastal corridor. Under the legitimate commercial front of Ballantine Imports & Exports, the syndicate exercises undisputed control over high-value artifact trade, private security contracting, magical asset transport, and harbor customs interception.

TERRITORIAL CODE & DYNAMICS:
1. Scottish Dragon Patriarch: Rory Ballantine commands absolute, fierce loyalty from his crew, viewing his criminal network as an extended family to be protected at any cost.
2. Northern Boundary Policy: The Ballantine Family strictly confines its heavy muscle and active racket operations to Greater Los Angeles and the southern coastal ports. Toward the north, in Solarton and Blackwood City, Rory maintains only commercial intermediaries and discreet informants. He respects House Douglas's sovereign pack territory, refusing to conduct unsanctioned enforcement operations on their soil.
3. Underworld Hub: Rory's Estate serves as the guarded sanctuary where syndicate summits, private agreements, and discreet transactions are settled over vintage scotch and fine cigars.

lexicon.name: Ambrosia (Sostanza Alchemica Illecita)
lexicon.content:
<Ambrosia>
Ambrosia is a highly addictive illicit magical substance primarily produced by the criminal syndicate known as the Sinners. It is a golden, shimmering liquid that is injected, but also comes in a powder format. When consumed, it grants users heightened magical powers or unlocks latent abilities temporarily at severe physical/psychological costs. Known side effects include addiction, instability, aggressive behavior shifts, severe withdrawal symptoms, and eventual mental deterioration. Its widespread abuse poses significant tension within the supernatural community.
</Ambrosia>

lexicon.name: Supernatural Underworld di Los Angeles
lexicon.content:
[FACTION: The Supernatural Underworld; TERRITORY: Greater Los Angeles Basin, Paradise District, Long Beach Harbors, Inland Ventura Smuggling Corridors; GOVERNANCE: De-centralized Syndicate Network, Mediated by the Ballantine Family; REACH: Southern and Central California Coast]

OVERVIEW: The Supernatural Underworld represents the clandestine shadow economy running parallel to mundane California society. Within its veiled network of underground clubs, hidden docks, and fortified warehouses, sentient supernaturals, rogue covens, and criminal syndicates trade in illicit alchemical narcotics like Ambrosia, black-market enchanted artifacts, unregistered soul stones, and discrete contract violence.

GEOGRAPHIC ANCHORS:
1. Paradise District (Los Angeles): The primary urban bazaar of the underworld, featuring high-end covert brokerages, VIP supernatural speakeasies, and illicit auction houses.
2. Long Beach & San Pedro Docks: The maritime smuggling entry point for off-world and European magical cargo, guarded by aquatic demihumans and gargoyle sentries.
3. Central Coast Smuggling Trails: Hidden mountain and canyon roads stretching through Ventura County toward Solarton, utilized by rogue couriers and werewolf runners.

INTERACTION WITH ESTABLISHED PACKS: The Underworld operates under an uneasy, tacit armed peace with House Douglas of Blackwood City and the corporate demon enclave of HSK Consulting. While open gang war is strictly suppressed by mutual agreement, the Underworld thrives by servicing appetites, secrets, and logistics that formal law cannot acknowledge.

lexicon.name: The Sinners (Gang Motociclistica Minotauri)
lexicon.content:
<Sinners>
The Sinners are a rival criminal syndicate notoriously known in Los Angeles' supernatural underworld for manufacturing/distributing Ambrosia, a dangerous magical narcotic causing widespread chaos within supernatural communities regionally/globally due its potency/addictive nature. Led by charming telepath Jean-Luc Virtuoso who personally harbors deep animosity toward Ruaraidh Ballantine, they constantly attempt territorial encroachment triggering frequent violent confrontations between gangs.

The Sinners are Los Angeles too, and the same limit applies to them: north of the city they work through local dealers and informants rather than their own people. Ambrosia reaches Solarton and Blackwood the way any drug reaches a college town, through somebody's cousin, and the Sinners themselves stay where their war is. A Sinner appearing in person in Blackwood would be an event, not a routine.
</Sinners>

lexicon.name: Russ & The Five Cocketeers (Dormitori SUCC)
lexicon.content:
<SUCC>
<dorm_life>
Russ and The Five Cocketeers
Russ is a high-energy, irreverent student at SUCC and a prominent member of The Five Cocketeers, a popular campus clique known for their social swagger and legendary parties. In the SUCC dormitory suites (Wyrm Hall), Russ is officially the dorm roommate of Jasper Douglas. Russ acts as an unruly counterweight to Jasper's intense, brooding focus on cybersecurity, signal intelligence, and audio mixing. Despite Jasper's quiet reserve, Russ regularly drags him into late-night taco runs, campus banter, and hallway antics, creating an affectionate, non-pack brotherhood that grounds Jasper in regular student life away from the heavy corporate politics of Villa Douglas.
</dorm_life>
</SUCC>

lexicon.name: Roman Blackwood & Kolya (SUCC Wrestling Team)
lexicon.content:
<SUCC>
<athletics>
Roman Blackwood, Kolya & The Wrestling Team
Roman Blackwood, an athletic demi-human standout possessing a single pair of animal ears, and his imposing teammate Kolya are heavyweight stars of the SUCC Varsity Wrestling Team. Renowned for their brute physical power, relentless conditioning, and disciplined submission techniques, they serve as regular off-campus gym companions and sparring partners to Malachia Björn Douglas. The bond between Malachia and the wrestling heavyweights is forged purely through iron, sweat, and grueling mat sessions where status is left at the locker room door. Malachia deeply respects their athletic dedication and uses their sparring bouts to test his close-quarters combat instincts without unleashing full supernatural frenzy.
</athletics>
</SUCC>

lexicon.name: Finnegan 'Finn' Novak (Amico d'Infanzia Douglas)
lexicon.content:
<SUCC>
<connections>
Finnegan 'Finn' Novak
Finnegan 'Finn' Novak is a canine demi-human (anatomically featuring a single pair of animal ears) and a lifelong childhood friend of the younger Douglas generation, having grown up alongside Alyssa, Jasper, and Noah. Easygoing, empathetic, and unbothered by pack dominance posturing, Finn represents a rare, enduring connection to genuine adolescence before corporate duties and bloodline expectations took over. At SUCC, Finn is a beloved presence who can walk into a room with any of the Douglas siblings, tease them freely, and share a completely relaxed conversation, acting as a treasured safe harbor of normalcy and unconditional friendship.
</connections>

Bakersfield & The NOVA Farm Pack
Located in the sun-baked agricultural basin of the southern Central Valley, Bakersfield is an expansive rural territory dominated by citrus groves, cattle pastures, and industrial farms. The region is home to NOVA Farm, a large and tightly knit rural werewolf pack. In stark contrast to the aristocratic, corporate hierarchy of the Douglas Seven Hills dynasty in Blackwood City, the NOVA Farm werewolves are dedicated to agriculture, manual craft, and open-range pack living. Working in harmony with human ranch hands and local growers, they live by hard physical labor and earthy traditions, harboring a healthy, working-class skepticism toward metropolitan boardroom politics and high-society purosangue protocols.

Dallas Rhodes
Dallas Rhodes is a massive, broad-shouldered werewolf who works as an agricultural farmer and cattle rancher in the rural territory of Bakersfield, having relocated to the California Central Valley to cultivate fertile land. Clad in denim work shirts with custom tail-slits and heavy leather work boots, Dallas embodies no-nonsense, blue-collar lupine fortitude. While deeply respectful of natural pack law and on friendly terms with the neighboring NOVA Farm community, Dallas operates his own sprawling farm with calm self-reliance. He treats people by how hard they work rather than their family pedigree, openly scoffing at urban corporate posturing while maintaining fierce loyalty to his agricultural neighbors.
